rows.note: This is the all-purpose colloquial verb for picking on, intimidating, or bullying someone.

example.english: They bully me all the time.
example.jyutping: keoi5 seng4 jat6 haa1 ngo5 gaa3

rows.note: Use this for a broader or more serious description of mistreating or bullying someone.

example.english: Don't bully the younger kids anymore.
example.jyutping: m4 hou2 zoi3 hei1 fu6 di1 sai3 lou6 laa3
